confidence_notes: London price data support the meal, coffee and beer anchors. The cocktail estimate uses local draught beer prices and a small downtown-club sample. Restaurant menus inform the wine estimate, though pour sizes vary. Lodging is modeled for typical July nights and varies by neighborhood and date. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/London) · [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/price/cocktail/london/GBP) · [Wine Labs](https://winelabs.ai/insights/wine-by-the-glass-prices-london-new-york-paris)
comparable_city_reasoning: Paris provides a broad comparison for summer lodging demand in a high-cost Western European capital.
